summary: TIM S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting board approval of a R$400 million interest on shareholders' equity (IE) distribution, equivalent to R$0.1674573219 gross per share. The payment date is July 22, 2026, with the record date for entitlement being June 22, 2026. Shares acquired after that date trade ex-IE. This represents a return of capital to shareholders, consistent with Brazilian corporate practice. No premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed. Observe the actual distribution yield versus the implied tax benefit for Brazilian holders.
